title: Deterministic Iteration
prompt: Implement kv_count and kv_iter: visit live slots in slot order, skipping tombstones and empty slots. A deleted key must never be observed again, and count must agree with iteration on every state.

tests.name: live slots in order
tests.hint: Tombstoned slots must be skipped, not reported.

tests.name: count agrees with iteration
tests.hint: kv_count and kv_iter must agree on every state.
